feeds.title: Libation Law Blog » Wine
feeds.description: Libation Law Blog is a legal news blog from alcoholic beverage and cannabis attorneys and regulatory insights from lawyers covering marijuana, craft beer, and wine.

feeds.title: WineLaw.ca
feeds.description: This site is dedicated to providing information on legal issues related to the wine industry in Canada, particularly BC. We cover such topics as shipping laws, marketing laws, labeling laws, environmental laws and licensing. All of the information presented here is written for the wine industry and for wine lovers.

feeds.title: On Reserve
feeds.description: On Reserve's mission is to provide wineries, vineyards, law students, lawyers, and those interested in wine and/or the law with the most comprehensive source of information on wine law. Through its publications, On Reserve supplies information on the international and domestic wine industries, the history of both international and domestic wine laws, and developing legal issues in the wine industry.

feeds.title: Wine & Law Program
feeds.description: The blog publishes articles, case-law notes, reports, briefs, and book reviews on national, comparative, European, and international law concerning wines and spirits as well as all relevant legal, economic, and academic information.

feeds.title: Fermentation » Wine Legal Battles
feeds.description: Read about and stay updated on Wine Legal Battles in this segment of the blog. Tom Wark began his career as a wine marketer and publicist in 1990. In 1994 he opened his own consultancy, Wark Communications, which serves small and medium-sized wineries and wine-related companies with media, communications, and marketing services.
